crossRefs.note: But you do see trouble and grief. You consider it to take it into your hand. You help the victim and the fatherless.
Yahweh, you have heard the desire of the humble. You will prepare their heart. You will cause your ear to hear,
All my bones shall say, “Yahweh, who is like you, who delivers the poor from him who is too strong for him; yes, the…
He will judge the poor of the people. He will save the children of the needy, and will break the oppressor in pieces.
For he will deliver the needy when he cries; the poor, who has no helper.
He will have pity on the poor and needy. He will save the souls of the needy.
Yet he lifts the needy out of their affliction, and increases their families like a flock.
For he will stand at the right hand of the needy, to save him from those who judge his soul.
I know that Yahweh will maintain the cause of the afflicted, and justice for the needy.

translations.web: But he saves from the sword of their mouth, even the needy from the hand of the mighty.
translations.bsb: He saves the needy from the sword in their mouth and from the clutches of the powerful.
translations.kjv: But he saveth the poor from the sword, from their mouth, and from the hand of the mighty.
translations.asv: But he saveth from the sword of their mouth, Even the needy from the hand of the mighty.
